maxPieceCells.description: Largest piece dealt, in cells. 3 deals only 1-3 cell pieces (singles, dominoes, 3-bars, small Ls); 4 adds the 2x2 square and 4-long bars; 5 adds the 5-long bars and big Ls (6-8 behave as 5); 9 adds the 3x3 block (the game's default, every shape). Takes effect on the next pieces dealt.
maxPieceCells.adjustment_guide: The main load lever. Lower (3-5) when LEVEL_FAILED comes after few PIECE_PLACED events, or for relax and young players. Raise to 9 once the player clears lines steadily (LINE_CLEARED often, multi-line clears).

piecesToPlace.description: Pieces placed before the tray refills its empty slots (the tray holds three). 1 refills after every placement, so there are always three pieces to choose from; 3 (the game's default) means using up the whole tray first, including awkward pieces. Applies immediately. Higher is harder.
piecesToPlace.adjustment_guide: Raise to 3 for planning and grit: the player must fit every piece they're dealt. Lower to 1 for relax or a struggling player, so an awkward piece can wait while others are placed.

adjustment_instructions:
Gummy Blocks: the player drags block shapes from a tray of three onto a 10x10 grid; filling a whole row or column clears it. The game ends when none of the pieces in the tray fits anywhere. There is no timer.
Levers: maxPieceCells is the main load lever (bigger shapes are harder to fit); piecesToPlace sets how many of the tray's pieces must be placed before it refills (higher = the player must use awkward pieces). Higher values of either are harder.
- relax: maxPieceCells 3-4, piecesToPlace 1.
- focus: maxPieceCells 5, piecesToPlace 2-3.
- grit: maxPieceCells 9, piecesToPlace 3; ease maxPieceCells down after an early LEVEL_FAILED.
- joy: maxPieceCells 4-5, piecesToPlace 1-2 (frequent line clears).
Only 3, 4, 5 and 9 differ for maxPieceCells. Change one knob at a time.
skill_adjustment_instructions:
Gummy Blocks trains Spatial reasoning and Visualization (seeing where a shape fits), with Planning (keeping room for the pieces still to come).
- spatial, visualization: maxPieceCells 5-9 so the shapes vary; piecesToPlace 1-2 so the challenge is fitting, not being forced.
- planning: piecesToPlace 3 and maxPieceCells 5-9, so every dealt piece must be placed and the board has to be kept open for big shapes.
notes: Gummy Blocks' difficulty knobs (fe-refactor#73), matching static/skillprintShim.js, ../parameters.json and GameAdjustmentTester's 'gummy-blocks' keys. Replaces the config seeded by marketplace migration 0009: boardRows, boardCols and gameSpeed are ignored by the game, and 0009 described piecesToPlace backwards (1-5, more = easier). scoreMultiplier is left out on purpose: it changes only the score, not difficulty, and rescales the score the portal reports.
